title: Date of Birth
description: A person's date of birth. 'format: date' IS enforced server-side by the validator (a malformed or non-calendar date is refused with VAL_SCHEMA_004). The Sorcha 'formatMaximum' token 'today' is NOT: it bounds the date picker in the renderer only, has no server-side consumer, and a future date submitted directly to the API is accepted and sealed. Treat the past-only bound as a UI affordance, not a validation constraint, and re-check it in your own action logic if it matters (see issue #1469).
